tasks.title: Implement Service Layer Abstraction for Backend API
tasks.description: Create a robust service layer in the frontend to handle all backend API interactions for topic generation, saving, and retrieval, ensuring secure authentication and error handling.
tasks.details: Use TypeScript to define service functions for POST /api/generate-topics, POST /api/topic/save-topic, and GET /api/topic/get-topics. Implement authentication via content-api-key header using environment variables (Next.js server-side environment config). Use Axios v1.6+ or native fetch with retry logic and error classification. Ensure all API contracts are strictly typed using TypeScript interfaces. Abstract error handling and recovery strategies for all endpoints.
tasks.testStrategy: Write Jest unit tests for each service function, including authentication header presence, correct request formatting, and error handling. Mock API responses for success, failure, and edge cases.

subtasks.title: Define TypeScript Interfaces for API Contracts
subtasks.description: Create strict TypeScript interfaces for request and response payloads for the /api/generate-topics, /api/topic/save-topic, and /api/topic/get-topics endpoints to ensure type safety and contract clarity.
subtasks.details: Analyze backend API documentation or OpenAPI specs to extract required fields and types. Define interfaces in a dedicated types file, ensuring all optional and required fields are accurately represented.
subtasks.testStrategy: Write Jest unit tests to validate that mock data conforms to the defined interfaces and that TypeScript enforces contract correctness.

subtasks.title: Implement Secure Authentication Handling
subtasks.description: Integrate authentication by injecting the content-api-key header into all service requests, sourcing the key from Next.js server-side environment variables.
subtasks.details: Use process.env for secure access to the API key. Ensure the header is present in all Axios or fetch requests and never exposed to the client bundle.
subtasks.testStrategy: Test that the authentication header is included in all outgoing requests using Jest and request mocking.

subtasks.title: Develop Service Functions for API Endpoints
subtasks.description: Implement robust TypeScript service functions for POST /api/generate-topics, POST /api/topic/save-topic, and GET /api/topic/get-topics, abstracting all backend interactions.
subtasks.details: Use Axios v1.6+ or native fetch to perform API calls. Each function should accept and return strictly typed data, handle serialization, and encapsulate endpoint URLs.
subtasks.testStrategy: Write Jest unit tests for each service function, mocking API responses for success, failure, and edge cases. Validate correct request formatting and response typing.

subtasks.title: Implement Error Handling and Retry Logic
subtasks.description: Abstract error classification (network, validation, backend) and implement retry logic for transient failures within the service layer.
subtasks.details: Design a reusable error handler to classify and format errors. Integrate retry logic (e.g., exponential backoff) for network or 5xx errors, and ensure all errors are surfaced with actionable messages.
subtasks.testStrategy: Simulate various error scenarios in Jest tests, verifying correct error classification, retry attempts, and error propagation.

subtasks.title: Document and Export Service Layer Abstraction
subtasks.description: Document the service layer API and export all service functions and types for use throughout the frontend application.
subtasks.details: Write clear JSDoc comments for each function and interface. Ensure all service functions are exported from a single entry point for easy import and maintainability.
subtasks.testStrategy: Review documentation for completeness and accuracy. Validate that all service functions and types are accessible and correctly typed in consuming modules.

tasks.title: Data Transformation Layer: Frontend to Backend Schema Mapping
tasks.description: Implement a transformation layer to map frontend GeneratedTopic objects to the backend topic schema required by the save-topic endpoint.
tasks.details: Create TypeScript utility functions to transform GeneratedTopic (and TopicBuilderFormData) to the backend schema (title, angle, channel_fit, audience_fit, scores, why_it_works, tags). Validate field presence and types using Zod v4.1.5. Ensure compatibility with backend expectations and handle edge cases (missing fields, type mismatches).
tasks.testStrategy: Write Jest unit tests for transformation functions, including valid/invalid input, edge cases, and schema mismatch scenarios. Use Zod validation to assert output structure.

subtasks.title: Define Frontend and Backend Schemas
subtasks.description: Document and clarify the structure and types of the frontend GeneratedTopic and TopicBuilderFormData objects, as well as the backend topic schema required by the save-topic endpoint.
subtasks.details: List all fields, types, and required/optional status for both frontend and backend schemas to ensure accurate mapping and validation.
subtasks.testStrategy: Peer review schema documentation for completeness and accuracy.

subtasks.title: Implement TypeScript Transformation Utilities
subtasks.description: Develop TypeScript utility functions to transform GeneratedTopic and TopicBuilderFormData objects into the backend topic schema format.
subtasks.details: Write pure functions that map and convert fields, handle renaming, and ensure all required backend fields are populated from frontend data.
subtasks.testStrategy: Write Jest unit tests for transformation logic, covering typical and edge-case inputs.

subtasks.title: Integrate Zod Validation for Field Presence and Types
subtasks.description: Use Zod v4.1.5 to validate the transformed data, ensuring all required fields are present and types match backend expectations.
subtasks.details: Define Zod schemas for the backend topic structure and integrate validation into the transformation utilities.
subtasks.testStrategy: Write Jest tests to assert that invalid or incomplete data triggers validation errors.

subtasks.title: Handle Edge Cases and Error Reporting
subtasks.description: Implement logic to manage edge cases such as missing fields, type mismatches, and unexpected input, providing clear error messages or fallback behaviors.
subtasks.details: Ensure the transformation layer gracefully handles all anticipated data issues and logs or returns actionable errors.
subtasks.testStrategy: Test with malformed, incomplete, and unexpected input data to verify robust error handling.

subtasks.title: Ensure Backend Compatibility and Maintainability
subtasks.description: Verify that the transformation output is fully compatible with the backend save-topic endpoint and document the mapping logic for future maintenance.
subtasks.details: Coordinate with backend developers to confirm schema alignment, and write clear documentation for the transformation and validation process.
subtasks.testStrategy: Perform integration tests with the backend endpoint and review documentation with stakeholders.

tasks.title: Integrate Topic Save Functionality in TopicActions Component
tasks.description: Connect the TopicActions component to the save-topic API, enabling users to save generated topics with proper loading states, error handling, and retry mechanisms.
tasks.details: Use React Hook Form v7.62.0 for form state and submission. Integrate the service layer and transformation utilities. Implement loading indicators (shadcn/ui Spinner), error alerts (ErrorAlert), and retry logic. Ensure optimistic UI updates and TanStack Query cache invalidation on successful save.
tasks.testStrategy: Write React Testing Library tests for TopicActions, covering save operation, loading state, error display, retry, and cache update. Use Jest mocks for API calls.

subtasks.title: Set Up React Hook Form for TopicActions Component
subtasks.description: Integrate React Hook Form v7.62.0 into the TopicActions component to manage form state and handle submission for saving topics.
subtasks.details: Define TypeScript types for form fields, initialize useForm with proper generics, and register input fields. Ensure form validation and submission are handled according to React Hook Form v7.62.0 best practices.
subtasks.testStrategy: Write React Testing Library tests to verify form state management, field registration, and submission behavior.

subtasks.title: Integrate Service Layer and Transformation Utilities
subtasks.description: Connect the TopicActions component to the save-topic API using the service layer and transformation utilities to map frontend data to backend schema.
subtasks.details: Invoke the service layer's save-topic function on form submission, utilizing transformation utilities to convert form data to the backend schema. Ensure strict typing and error handling during the API call.
subtasks.testStrategy: Mock API calls in Jest and verify correct data transformation and service invocation.

subtasks.title: Implement Loading Indicators and Error Handling
subtasks.description: Display loading indicators during save operations and show error alerts when API calls fail, providing retry options.
subtasks.details: Use shadcn/ui Spinner for loading states and ErrorAlert for error display. Implement retry logic to allow users to attempt saving again after a failure.
subtasks.testStrategy: Test loading and error states using React Testing Library, simulating API delays and failures.

subtasks.title: Enable Optimistic UI Updates and TanStack Query Cache Invalidation
subtasks.description: Update the UI optimistically upon save initiation and invalidate TanStack Query cache on successful topic save to ensure data consistency.
subtasks.details: Implement optimistic UI updates to reflect saved topics immediately. Use TanStack Query's cache invalidation methods to refresh topic data after a successful save.
subtasks.testStrategy: Verify optimistic updates and cache invalidation with React Testing Library and Jest mocks.

subtasks.title: Write Comprehensive Tests for Save Functionality
subtasks.description: Develop React Testing Library tests for the TopicActions component, covering save operation, loading state, error display, retry logic, optimistic updates, and cache invalidation.
subtasks.details: Create test cases for all critical paths, including successful saves, API failures, retries, and UI state transitions. Use Jest to mock API responses and TanStack Query behaviors.
subtasks.testStrategy: Ensure all features are covered by automated tests, including edge cases and error scenarios.

tasks.title: Implement Success Messaging and Navigation Options Post-Save
tasks.description: Provide user feedback after successful topic save, including confirmation messaging and navigation options to Ideas page or topic generation.
tasks.details: Use shadcn/ui AlertDialog for confirmation. Implement navigation using Next.js router (useRouter). Ensure accessibility compliance (ARIA roles, focus management). Integrate with TopicActions component to trigger messaging and navigation.
tasks.testStrategy: Write React Testing Library tests for success messaging, navigation actions, and accessibility (focus, ARIA attributes).

subtasks.title: Design Success Confirmation Messaging
subtasks.description: Create a clear and accessible success message to display after a topic is saved, using shadcn/ui AlertDialog for modal presentation.
subtasks.details: Define the messaging content, including title and description, ensuring it communicates successful save and next steps. Structure the AlertDialog using shadcn/ui components with appropriate ARIA roles and focus management.
subtasks.testStrategy: Write React Testing Library tests to verify message visibility, correct ARIA attributes, and focus behavior.

subtasks.title: Implement Navigation Options in Confirmation Dialog
subtasks.description: Add navigation actions to the AlertDialog, allowing users to proceed to the Ideas page or initiate topic generation.
subtasks.details: Integrate Next.js useRouter to handle navigation actions triggered from dialog buttons. Ensure navigation options are clearly labeled and accessible within the dialog.
subtasks.testStrategy: Test navigation actions using React Testing Library and Next.js router mocks to confirm correct routing and button accessibility.

subtasks.title: Integrate Success Messaging and Navigation with TopicActions Component
subtasks.description: Connect the success confirmation dialog and navigation logic to the TopicActions component, triggering them after a successful topic save.
subtasks.details: Modify TopicActions to invoke the AlertDialog upon successful save, passing necessary props for messaging and navigation. Ensure seamless integration with existing save logic.
subtasks.testStrategy: Write integration tests to verify that saving a topic triggers the dialog and navigation options, using Jest and React Testing Library.

subtasks.title: Ensure Accessibility Compliance for Dialog and Navigation
subtasks.description: Audit and enhance the AlertDialog and navigation controls for accessibility, including ARIA roles, keyboard navigation, and focus management.
subtasks.details: Review dialog structure for ARIA compliance, test keyboard navigation (Tab, Enter, Escape), and ensure focus is managed correctly when the dialog opens and closes.
subtasks.testStrategy: Use automated accessibility testing tools and manual keyboard navigation tests to validate compliance.

subtasks.title: Write Comprehensive Tests for Success Messaging and Navigation
subtasks.description: Develop unit and integration tests covering success messaging display, navigation actions, and accessibility features.
subtasks.details: Create test cases for dialog rendering, message content, navigation button actions, ARIA attributes, and focus management. Simulate user interactions and edge cases.
subtasks.testStrategy: Use React Testing Library and Jest to automate tests for all dialog and navigation scenarios, including accessibility checks.

tasks.title: Replace Ideas Page Dummy Data with Real API Integration

tasks.details: Use TanStack Query v5 to fetch topics, handle loading/error states, and cache results. Integrate the service layer for API calls. Ensure authentication header is included. Display loading spinners and error alerts as needed.
tasks.testStrategy: Write integration tests for Ideas page data fetching, loading/error states, and cache behavior. Mock API responses for various scenarios.

subtasks.title: Remove Dummy Data and Prepare Ideas Page for API Integration
subtasks.description: Eliminate all placeholder and hardcoded topic data from the Ideas page to ensure only real API data will be displayed.
subtasks.details: Audit the Ideas page for any mock data, static arrays, or placeholder UI elements. Refactor the component to expect dynamic data from the backend.
subtasks.testStrategy: Verify that no dummy data is rendered by default and the page remains functional before API integration.

subtasks.title: Implement Service Layer for get-topics API with Authentication
subtasks.description: Create or update a service function to call the get-topics API, ensuring the authentication header is included in all requests.
subtasks.details: Use TypeScript to define the API call, handle request/response typing, and inject the authentication token from context or storage.
subtasks.testStrategy: Write unit tests for the service function, mocking API responses and verifying correct header inclusion and error handling.

subtasks.title: Integrate TanStack Query v5 for Topics Fetching and Caching
subtasks.description: Use TanStack Query v5 to fetch topics from the service layer, manage cache, and expose loading and error states to the Ideas page.

subtasks.title: Display Loading Spinners and Error Alerts on the Ideas Page
subtasks.description: Render appropriate loading indicators and error messages on the Ideas page based on the TanStack Query state.
subtasks.details: Show a spinner or skeleton UI when data is loading, and display an error alert with retry options if the API call fails.

subtasks.title: Render Real Topics Data in the Ideas Page UI
subtasks.description: Map the fetched topics data to the UI components, ensuring all topic fields are displayed correctly and the page updates reactively.
subtasks.details: Bind the topics data from TanStack Query to the Ideas page components, replacing all previous static content with dynamic rendering.
subtasks.testStrategy: Write integration tests to verify that real API data is displayed, updates on refetch, and UI remains consistent with backend changes.

tasks.title: Map Backend Response to IdeaData Interface

tasks.details: Create TypeScript utility functions to map backend topic objects to IdeaData. Validate field mapping and handle missing/extra fields. Use Zod for runtime validation. Ensure compatibility with DataTable and other UI components.
tasks.testStrategy: Write Jest unit tests for adapter functions, covering all field mappings, edge cases, and validation errors.

subtasks.title: Analyze Backend Topic Response and IdeaData Interface
subtasks.description: Review the backend topic response schema and the frontend IdeaData interface to identify all fields, types, and required mappings.
subtasks.details: Document all fields present in both the backend response and the IdeaData interface, noting any differences in naming, type, or structure. Identify required, optional, and extra fields.
subtasks.testStrategy: Verify completeness by cross-referencing backend and frontend type definitions. Ensure all fields are accounted for and ambiguities are resolved.

subtasks.title: Design Field Mapping and Transformation Logic
subtasks.description: Define explicit mapping rules and transformation logic to convert backend topic objects to the IdeaData interface, including handling of missing or extra fields.
subtasks.details: Specify how each backend field maps to the corresponding IdeaData field, including any necessary type conversions, default values, or computed fields. Document handling for missing or unexpected fields.
subtasks.testStrategy: Create mapping documentation and sample mapping tables. Review with team or stakeholders for correctness.

subtasks.title: Implement TypeScript Adapter Utility Functions
subtasks.description: Develop TypeScript utility functions that perform the mapping and transformation from backend topic objects to the IdeaData interface.
subtasks.details: Write pure functions or static class methods to encapsulate the mapping logic. Ensure functions are reusable and maintainable, and support mapping of both single objects and arrays.
subtasks.testStrategy: Write Jest unit tests for all mapping functions, covering typical, missing, and extra field scenarios.

subtasks.title: Integrate Zod Runtime Validation
subtasks.description: Use Zod schemas to validate backend data before and after transformation, ensuring runtime type safety and clear error reporting.
subtasks.details: Define Zod schemas for both the backend response and the IdeaData interface. Integrate validation into the adapter functions, with error handling for invalid data.
subtasks.testStrategy: Write Jest tests to verify that invalid data is correctly rejected and errors are descriptive. Test with both valid and invalid payloads.

subtasks.title: Ensure Compatibility with DataTable and UI Components
subtasks.description: Test and adjust the adapter output to guarantee seamless integration with DataTable and other frontend UI components.
subtasks.details: Validate that the mapped IdeaData objects render correctly in DataTable and other relevant UI components. Address any issues with field formats, missing data, or UI expectations.
subtasks.testStrategy: Perform integration tests in the frontend, using real and mock data. Confirm correct display, sorting, and filtering in DataTable and other components.

tasks.title: Update DataTable Component for Real Topic Metadata

subtasks.title: Integrate DataTable with Backend for Real Topic Metadata
subtasks.description: Connect the DataTable component to the backend API to fetch and display real topic metadata, ensuring all columns (scores, tags, audience_fit, etc.) are populated with accurate data.

subtasks.title: Implement Sorting, Pagination, and Search Functionality
subtasks.description: Enable sorting, pagination, and search features in the DataTable, leveraging TanStack Table v8 capabilities and shadcn/ui controls.
subtasks.details: Configure column definitions for sortable headers, set up pagination controls, and add a search input that filters table rows based on user input.

subtasks.title: Add Advanced Filtering Based on Backend Data
subtasks.description: Implement advanced filtering options (e.g., by tags, scores, audience_fit) that interact with backend data and update the DataTable accordingly.

subtasks.testStrategy: Test export actions for correct file generation and data integrity using unit and integration tests.

tasks.title: Implement Error Handling and Retry Mechanisms Across UI
tasks.description: Ensure comprehensive error handling and retry logic for all API interactions, including contextual error messages and user-friendly recovery options.
tasks.details: Use APIErrorBoundary and ErrorAlert components for error display. Implement retry logic in service layer and UI components. Classify errors (network, validation, backend) and provide actionable messages. Integrate with TanStack Query error handling patterns.
tasks.testStrategy: Write unit and integration tests for error scenarios, retry logic, and error message display. Simulate network failures and backend errors.

subtasks.title: Integrate APIErrorBoundary and ErrorAlert Components Across UI
subtasks.description: Wrap all API-interacting UI components with APIErrorBoundary and ensure ErrorAlert is used to display contextual error messages, preventing application crashes and providing fallback UIs.

subtasks.description: Develop robust retry mechanisms for API calls in the service layer and expose retry options in UI components, allowing users to recover from transient failures.

subtasks.title: Classify and Handle Error Types with Actionable Messages
subtasks.description: Detect and classify errors (network, validation, backend) in the service layer, and map them to actionable, user-friendly messages displayed in the UI.

subtasks.title: Integrate TanStack Query Error Handling Patterns
subtasks.description: Align error handling and retry logic with TanStack Query's patterns, leveraging its hooks and configuration for consistent API state management.

subtasks.testStrategy: Write integration tests for components using TanStack Query. Simulate API errors and verify error states, retry logic, and UI feedback are handled as expected.

subtasks.title: Test Error Handling, Retry Logic, and User Recovery Flows
subtasks.description: Develop comprehensive unit and integration tests to validate error handling, retry mechanisms, and user recovery options across all API interactions.
subtasks.details: Simulate network failures, backend errors, and validation issues in tests. Assert correct error containment, message display, retry behavior, and recovery flows. Use Jest and React Testing Library for coverage.
subtasks.testStrategy: Write test suites covering all error scenarios, retry logic, and user recovery actions. Ensure tests validate both service layer and UI component behaviors.

tasks.title: Ensure Responsive and Accessible UI Design

Implement progressive disclosure (collapsible advanced options) and ensure all forms and dialogs are ARIA-compliant. Test on multiple device sizes and screen readers.
